nodes.text:
➠ 14 How long will this effect the market?

Likely not for long

◈ It’s expected that these will remain isolated cases, with no pandemic on the horizon

◈ Unlike 2020, we are far more prepared, thanks to our experience with C-19

◈ While it could lead to an investment outflow for a few months, it’s more likely the market will stabilize much sooner

◈ I’m not a biologist or virologist, so I could be wrong, but the current data doesn’t suggest a long-term disruption
